metadata.title: Snakes mating in my backyard | PDA
metadata.description: I woke up to a rather amusing public display of affection by two very large snakes in my backyard. The snakes seen in the video are rat snakes which are non-venomous variety of snakes commonly found throughout India. The mating ritual went on for about an hour and the whole sight of it looked splendid and scary at the same time.
